title: Author root CMakeLists.txt build config
description:
Create the root CMakeLists.txt for AuralMaximizerPro: use the existing JUCE 8.0.13 checkout at ./JUCE through the normal repository-relative integration add_subdirectory(JUCE), set C++20, juce_add_plugin with COMPANY_NAME nSpace / CODE Axpr, FORMATS Standalone VST3 LV2, link juce_audio_utils juce_audio_processors juce_dsp juce_gui_basics juce_gui_extra, juce_generate_juce_header, and target_sources listing every Source/ stub path from the phase expected files. Do not use FetchContent, package-manager installation, another JUCE copy, or another external dependency.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY CMakeLists.txt.

Before editing, inspect: existing repo root for JUCE layout, any legacy build files, and expected Source/ paths listed in the phase goal.
acceptance_criteria: CMakeLists.txt sets C++20 and juce_add_plugin with COMPANY_NAME nSpace CODE Axpr
CMakeLists.txt includes FORMATS Standalone VST3 LV2
CMakeLists.txt target_sources references PluginProcessor PluginEditor and all DSP/GUI stub paths
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add third-party dependencies beyond the existing JUCE submodule

allowed: Ninja-oriented cmake-build-debug as documented build dir
forbidden: implement DSP or GUI logic in CMake
